raw_blocks: Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. is the parent company of University of Phoenix, Inc., a pioneer in online education for working adults. Founded in 1976, University of Phoenix provides access to higher education opportunities that enable students to develop the knowledge and skills necessary to achieve their professional goals, improve the performance of their organizations and provide leadership and service to their communities.
We Are a Mission-Driven Organization

The mission of University of Phoenix is to provide access to higher education opportunities that enable students to develop the knowledge and skills necessary to achieve their professional goals, improve the performance of their organizations and provide leadership and service to their communities.
Leading Brand in Growing Market
Meaningful Scale with ~80,000 Average Total Degreed Enrollment
100+ Programs Aligned to 300+ Careers

Whether you’re a seasoned professional or just starting your career journey, University of Phoenix offers opportunities that can help shape your future. We believe in cultivating an environment of learning and growth, not just for our students, but for our staff as well. Our diverse team is committed to influencing education — and society — for the better.

pages.raw_title: Phoenix Education Partners | About - About Us
raw_blocks: Personalized, career-relevant, and affordable education

We deliver personalized, career-relevant, and affordable education designed to help learners achieve their goals. Our flexible, 100+ high-quality programs are supported by dedicated faculty with an average of 29 years of experience in their fields who put students first. An innovative technology platform provides a seamless, engaging experience that enhances learning outcomes and student satisfaction.
Teaching skills in weeks, not years

We are committed to helping people be more productive in their jobs today and prepare them for internal mobility opportunities tomorrow. Our Career Services for Life ® supports active students and graduates through their academic and professional journey.
Solutions to meet the needs of employers and their workforce
We partner with employers, with 2,500+ employer alliances, to provide skills-based solutions to address employers’ talent needs for hiring, upskilling, reskilling, and retention.

Built on a strong financial foundation, we are positioned for sustained growth and continued impact. By combining multiple pathways for success, deep industry expertise, and a student-centered culture, we remain a differentiated, market leader in higher education.
